properties.title: Request Errors (5xx)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/insurance-agent' | fields @timestamp, path, status_code, latency_ms | filter status_code >= 500 | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50

properties.title: Slow Requests (> 2000ms)
properties.query: SOURCE '/ecs/insurance-agent' | fields @timestamp, path, latency_ms, request_id | filter latency_ms > 2000 | sort latency_ms desc | limit 20
